outcome: Wound complications (seroma, hematoma, dehiscence, or infection)
cohort: Parturients ages 18-45 with BMI greater than 40
finding: While not statistically significant, high transverse skin incisions showed a trend towards reducing wound complications in parturients with obesity, but were also associated with lower Apgar scores, increased NICU admissions, and earlier gestational age at delivery.
